q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
Today is August 23, 2026. NVIDIA will release Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026. This leaves approximately **3 days** until resolution.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**

NVIDIA has already provided formal forward guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which establishes a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion.

With only 3 days until the earnings release, this guidance is effectively locked in. Companies rarely revise guidance between quarterly earnings announcements absent extraordinary circumstances. The current research indicates:
- NVIDIA explicitly guided to $91.0B ± 2% in their Q1 FY2027 earnings (May 20, 2026)
- Wall Street consensus is $91.9B, comfortably within NVIDIA's guided range
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue was $81.6B
- The guidance explicitly assumes zero Data Center compute revenue from China

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm or only marginally adjust this $91.0B guidance on August 26, 2026. Any significant variance at this point would be extraordinary.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**
- Major unexpected supply chain disruptions or production delays
- Unexpected sharp decline in AI/datacenter demand
- Unforeseen geopolitical developments (additional export restrictions beyond the already-baked-in China assumption)
- Major customer cancellations or push-outs of orders
- However, with only 3 days remaining and guidance already issued, material downward revisions are highly unlikely

**(d) What would push the value higher?**
- Better-than-expected demand forcing supply constraints
- Data Center demand stronger than anticipated
- Customer concentration risk lower than modeled
- Possible upside to guidance if conditions have improved since May 20
- However, companies tend to be conservative with guidance; significant upward revisions in the final 3 days are rare

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**

From the current research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 revenue: $81.6 billion (actual)
- Q2 FY2027 forward guidance: $91.0 billion ± 2% ($89.2B to $92.8B range)
- Wall Street consensus: $91.9 billion
- This represents approximately 11.5% sequential growth from Q1 to Q2

The guidance has already been formally issued. The question asks what NVIDIA's forward guidance *will be* in the Q2 earnings release — meaning the forward guidance they will announce on August 26, 2026 for Q3 FY2027 (not actual Q2 results).

**Critical clarification:** This question likely asks for the *forward guidance* they provide on August 26 for the *next* quarter (Q3 FY2027), not actual Q2 results. Given NVIDIA's track record of conservative guidance and the current momentum (Q1 grew 85% YoY), forward guidance for Q3 would typically be:
- Within their historical guidance accuracy (usually ±2%)
- Conservative relative to consensus expectations
- Reflecting continued demand but acknowledging geopolitical risks (China restrictions)

Given the range provided (99.5B to 115.5B is much higher than the Q2 guidance of 91.0B), this strongly suggests the question is asking about Q3 FY2027 guidance to be provided on August 26.

Assuming sequential growth similar to Q1→Q2 (11-12% or potentially higher given AI momentum), Q3 guidance might reasonably be in the **$100-103 billion range**, representing mid-to-high single-digit sequential growth or continued strong momentum.

**Most likely estimate: $101.5 billion** for Q3 FY2027 forward guidance (roughly 11.5% sequential growth similar to Q2).

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**, according to their Q1 FY2027 earnings report released on May 20, 2026 [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) and [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance implies a ceiling near $92.8 billion and a floor near $89.2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

This outlook explicitly assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) and [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street's average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.9 billion, which falls within NVIDIA's guided range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). For comparison, Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). NVIDIA will release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26 [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).
